Ronald Dwayne Whitfield

Republican candidate for U.S. Representative, District 18, Harris County, Texas · Challenger

Landscaping contractor

Ronald Dwayne Whitfield is a Houston Republican and a landscaping contractor. He won the March 3, 2026 Republican primary for Texas' 18th Congressional District over Elizabeth Vences, 55.1% to 44.9% (4,449 votes to 3,625). He faces U.S. Rep. Christian Dashaun Menefee (D) in the November 3, 2026 general election.
